name: Kausal Media (Ancient Papyrus & Batik)
description: Light-mode investigative visual essay aesthetic combining aged papyrus textures, Indonesian Batik Parang Rusak watermarks, cinnabar wax stamps, sumi ink typography, and anti-YouTube-flagging narrative cadence.

aiPromptSpec.promptPrefix: Crisp isolated spot illustration in vintage European comic ligne claire art style, Herge and Tintin aesthetic, clean crisp uniform black ink contour outlines, flat warm color wash fill, modern day Jakarta context, authentic Indonesian elements
aiPromptSpec.negativePrompt: complex background, landscape, street view, horizon, clouds, trees, crowds, multiple unrelated objects, speech bubbles, modern text, 3D CGI, photorealistic

character.treatment: Clean European ligne claire ink linework and flat watercolor wash, modern Jakarta attire (batik slim-fit kemeja, corporate ID lanyard), waist-up bust crop focusing on hands, props, and facial expression with natural organic bottom edge, zero caricature, no full-body unless strictly relevant
character.role: Modern investigative observer or forensic analyst in context, never talking-head narrator

pacing.actTransitions: Continuous fluid paper-tear, match-cut, or occlusion wipe; zero chapter bumpers or title cards

antiSlopRules: Strictly zero throat-clearing ('di era serba cepat', 'menyelami lebih dalam', 'tak dapat dipungkiri')
Ground every claim in balance sheets, court rulings, or chronological dates
Wrap proper acronyms in phonetic syntax: [BEI|B-E-I], [VOC|V-O-C], [PKPU|P-K-P-U], [UU|U-U]
Never repeat the same visual asset more than 3 times across the entire video

stylingTips.pacing: Target 130–138 WPM with varied sentence cadence. Alternate punchy 3–5 word statements with complex causal clauses.
stylingTips.exhibits: Use aged papyrus, deckled edges, lontar palm leaf dockets, and archival sepia photography.
stylingTips.annotations: Use cinnabar wax stamps (RAHASIA, VERIFIED, VOID) and amber ink highlighters for key evidentiary text.
stylingTips.dataGraphics: Parchment ledger breakdown with gold accents and odometer ticker dynamic count-up.
stylingTips.antiSlopRules: Eliminate all generic AI intros and moralizing outros. End strictly on verifiable balance sheet realities or causal conclusions.
